setlist.title: It's All Over Now, Baby Blue

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Shakedown Street** (3 reviews): Jerry fumbles verses and gets lost in solos during the performance; Performance is badly bungled, making it hilarious to listen to [11][16][18]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): First set is solid with above average playing and clear sound [17]
- **It's All Over Now, Baby Blue** (1 review): Reviewer calls it the best Baby Blue they have seen [14]

## The recordings

- **gd1982-12-28.mtx.chappell.sb18b.34715.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 173 min; rated 4.67/5 by 6 [1]
- **gd82-12-28.sbd.hinko.18980.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 165 min; rated 4.1/5 by 21 [2]. Said about its sound: Sound is very good, except Baby Blue is patched from another B+ quality SBD; Band sounded together on FM broadcast, but came apart in second set [11][17]
- **gd82-12-28.sbd-pcm.miller.31967.sbeok.flacf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 172 min; rated 3.33/5 by 6 [3]. Said about its sound: No transition exists between On the Road Again and Touch of Grey; Excellent sound for a late '82 board, rated 3.5 or 4.0 [19][20]
- **gd1982-12-28.150890.fob.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac1648**: source not stated; 22 songs; 166 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd1982-12-28.147922.senn421.hecht.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 22 songs; 160 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [6]

## Around the show

- Crowd was wild, with the roof nearly coming off the venue [14]
- Band sounds weak compared to the killer 12/30 and 31 shows [11]
- First set was amazing, while the second set was so-so [15]
- Reviewer suggests the 12/27 show is better than this one [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1982-12-28.mtx.chappell.sb18b.34715.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Chris Chappell; source: MTX: SBD(31967) + AUD(?????) [1]
- **gd82-12-28.sbd.hinko.18980.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > MC > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN [2]
- **gd82-12-28.sbd-pcm.miller.31967.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [3]. Also: Transferred and edited by Charlie Miller; seamless transition between discs [3]
- **gd1982-12-28.150890.fob.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Recorded by Bob Wagner; source: Bob Wagner's Master (FOB) Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony D5M [4]. Also: Bob Wagner provided master cassettes; Charlie Miller transferred and coordinated [4]
- **gd1982-12-28.147922.senn421.hecht.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Chris Hecht; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Chris Hecht's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 421 mics > Sony D5M [6]. Also: Chris Hecht provided master; Mark Fulton's FOB Nakamichi 300 supplies patches [6]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Gregg Nixon Grateful Dead: [1982-12-31 Oakland Auditorium Arena, Oakland, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1982-12-31-oakland-auditorium-arena-oakland-ca-usa/) [24]
